blueprint.fail_threw: Wannan matakin ya ci karo da kuskure.

blueprint.preview_missing: Wancan kayan aikin ba ya cikin wannan wurin aiki kuma. Sake gina matakin don sake yin sa.

blueprint.run_stopped: An tsayar. Kayan aiki {done} daga {total} sun gama kafin tsayawa — sauran suna nuna Sake ginawa don ka yi su ɗaya-ɗaya ko ka sake fara shirin.
blueprint.stop_run_hint: Yana gama matakin da ake yi, sannan ya tsaya. Ana ajiye kayan aikin da suka gama.
blueprint.template_directive_help: Ajiye umarnin da za su dace da kowane batu. Share waɗanda ke bayanin WANNAN darasin kawai.
